sources.title: Golden Whip Stream: a Paradise for Hikers in Zhangjiajie
sources.content:
Golden Whip Stream is located in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park's southern section. The stream flows 7.5 kilometers through mountains and forests, named after Golden Whip Rock. It's recognized as a gallery of natural landscapes and a paradise for hikers featuring rare plants and wildlife.

Key Facts:
Location: Southern Zhangjiajie National Forest Park near Zhonghu Town
Hours: 7:00-18:00
Duration: 2-3 hours
Best season: March to November
Access: Included in park ticket (CNY 248)
Difficulty: Easy, flat walkway suitable for elderly visitors and children

What to See:
Golden Whip Rock (resembling a whip), Rock of Magical Hawk Protecting the Whip, Splitting the Mountain to Save Mother. Purple Grass Pond with purple-red sandstone on the bottom and natural stone bridge overhead. Jumping Fish Pool shows fish leaping upstream during spring and summer.

Flora: Liriodendron trees, phoebe zhennan, and lobster flowers.
Wildlife: Wild macaques commonly encountered; maintain distance and avoid feeding.

Recommended Routes:
Route 1 (Classic): East Entrance → Ten-Mile Gallery → Golden Whip Stream → Huangshi Village → South Entrance (5-6 hours, medium)
Route 2 (Leisure): East Gate → Ten-Mile Gallery → Golden Whip Stream → East Gate (4-5 hours, low)
Route 3 (Advanced): South Gate → entire Golden Whip Stream → climb to Yuanjiajie → Bailong Elevator (6-7 hours, high)

Tips: Stay alert around wild macaques; bring umbrella/raincoat; pack water and snacks; best photography early morning or after 15:00; avoid mid-day tour groups. Restrooms near Great Oxygen Bar Square, Purple Grass Pond, and Shui Rao Si Men.

sources.title: Golden Whip Stream, Golden Whip Brook Zhangjiajie
sources.content: Golden Whip Stream (Jinbianxi) is the most stunning hiking path in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park that meanders 7.5 km. Named after the Golden Whip Rock, one of the 10 wonders of Zhangjiajie. The complete trail takes 2-3 hours one way at a leisurely pace. Along this 7-km-long stream, there are no obstacles, so it is suitable even for children and elderly people. Best times are before 09:00 or after 15:00 for quietest experience and best lighting.

sources.title: Golden Whip Stream | ChinaGoTrip
sources.content: Golden Whip Stream is part of Zhangjiajie National Forest Park. The stream is 7.5 km long with a flat, easy trail suitable for all fitness levels. Key attractions along the trail include the Golden Whip Rock, Hawk Protecting the Whip, and Purple Grass Pond. The stream is included in the park entry ticket. Best visited in spring and autumn.

sources.title: Golden Whip Stream: One of Zhangjiajie's Most Scenic Parts
sources.content: Golden Whip Stream is one of Zhangjiajie's most scenic parts. The stream trail runs through the heart of the national forest park, offering views of towering sandstone pillars, lush vegetation, and crystal-clear water. The flat path makes it one of the most accessible hikes in the park.

sources.title: Golden Whip Stream in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park
sources.content: Golden Whip Stream comprehensive guide. The stream flows through the southeastern section of the park, named after the golden-colored rock that resembles a whip. Start from the South Gate for the best experience. Open daily 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Beware of wild macaques at the entrance and rest areas.

sources.title: 金鞭溪风景区_百度百科
sources.content:
金鞭溪风景区是湖南张家界市的国家AAAAA级景区，位于武陵源区张家界国家森林公园东部。开放时间7:00-18:00，门票免费（含在景区门票内）。

溪水发源于土地垭，自西向东蜿蜒7.5公里至水绕四门，因流经金鞭岩而得名。溪谷植被茂盛、水质清澈，被誉为山水画廊和人间仙境。

金鞭岩相对高度380米，由石英砂构成，阳光照射下呈金色光泽。神鹰护鞭景观展现一山峰似护雏的老鹰守护金鞭岩的景象。

景区包含迎宾岩、母子峰、醉罗汉、劈山救母、文星岩、紫草潭、千里相会、骆驼峰等多处景观。建议游玩2-3小时，全年适宜，春秋季最佳。

2025年启动阿凡达奇遇·西游巡山活动，融合影视IP体验与沉浸式互动。景区配备无障碍通道及应急医疗服务。

sources.title: 张家界金鞭溪_百度百科
sources.content:
张家界金鞭溪全长6.5公里，自西向东贯通森林公园，两岸奇峰屏列，风光如画。金鞭溪所经之地被誉为世界上最美丽的峡谷。主要景致有醉罗汉、神鹰护鞭、金鞭岩、花果山、水帘洞、劈山救母等。

金鞭岩拔地而起380多米，整块岩石为石英砂构成，在阳光的照耀下反射出熠熠金光。

金鞭溪里有国家一级保护植物珙桐和水杉；沿溪遍布龙虾花，该花形似龙虾，属张家界特有古老花种。
